owner_posts.post_text:
At Equalifi's 14th Indian Family Office Summit, Spark Capital PWM was pleased to be part of a session that addressed one of the most consequential — and often overlooked — dimensions of family wealth: the role of women in governance and succession.
 
"Women in Family Business – From Invisible to Indispensable" brought together Arpita Vinay - Senior Managing Director & CEO, Spark Capital PWM, Ritu George Muthoot - Director, Muthoot Pappachan Group, and Aasiya Tejani - Director, Gits Food Products Pvt.Ltd for a candid conversation on how women in India's family enterprises are transitioning from informal influence to formal, decision-making authority.
 
Key themes from the discussion:
 
→ Redefining succession beyond bloodline hierarchy to capability and vision
 → Structuring governance frameworks that reflect the full spectrum of family stakeholders
 → The role of next-generation women in shaping — not just inheriting — family legacy
 → Why inclusive governance is not merely an ethical imperative, but a continuity strategy
 
For family offices, the takeaway is clear: the families best positioned for multi-generational resilience are those that bring every voice — including women — into formal structures with accountability and intention.
 
We thank Equalifi for convening this important conversation, and our panelists for their candour and clarity.

In a recent interaction with ET Now Swadesh, Devang Mehta, Deputy Managing Director & Chief Investment Officer – Equity, Spark Capital PWM, shared his perspectives on the current market landscape and the key factors shaping investor sentiment.
 
Key highlights from the discussion:
• Recent market corrections have improved valuations, making the overall risk-reward equation more attractive for investors
 • Declining crude oil prices and a strengthening rupee are positive macroeconomic developments supporting market sentiment
 • India's structural growth story remains intact, backed by resilient corporate earnings and strong domestic economic fundamentals
 • Domestic liquidity continues to provide stability and support to equity markets amid global uncertainties
 • Maintaining a disciplined and long-term investment approach remains critical for wealth creation through market cycles
 • Select sectors and themes are presenting attractive opportunities for investors willing to look beyond short-term volatility
 
As markets continue to respond to evolving economic and geopolitical developments, periods of correction often create opportunities to accumulate quality businesses at reasonable valuations. Staying focused on fundamentals and long-term value creation remains essential.
 
At Spark Capital PWM, we continue to focus on identifying high-quality businesses backed by strong fundamentals and long-term growth potential. Through a disciplined, research-driven investment approach,

We are pleased to share that Devang Mehta, Deputy Managing Director & Chief Investment Officer – Equity NDPMS, Spark Capital PWM, participated in WealthTHINK India 2026, Hubbis' flagship forum that brought together CEOs, CIOs, family office leaders, and senior wealth management professionals to discuss the evolving landscape of private wealth in India.

Here's what stood out:
 
- Volatility is noise — process is signal

 - Quality businesses with strong fundamentals remain the cornerstone of resilient portfolios

Women are increasingly shaping the future of family wealth, governance, and legacy.
 
We are pleased to see this important conversation take centre stage at the 14th Indian Family Office Summit by Equalifi. The session, "Women in Family Business – From Invisible to Indispensable," highlights the evolving role of women as influential decision-makers, stewards of family enterprises, and drivers of long-term value creation.
 
As family businesses and family offices continue to evolve, fostering diverse perspectives and inclusive leadership remains critical to sustainable growth and effective governance.
 
We look forward to the insights shared by the distinguished panelists Arpita Vinay, Ritu George Muthoot , and Aasiya Tejani on this important subject.

Spark Capital is honoured to return as the Presenting Sponsor of the ET NOW Family Business Excellence Summit & Awards 2026 — this time in Bengaluru, July 2026.

Following a memorable first edition in Mumbai last year, we're excited to once again be part of a platform that celebrates the enterprises that have endured, evolved, and inspired across generations.

Family businesses are the backbone of India's economy driving growth, creating livelihoods, and building legacies that outlast market cycles. This association is a reflection of our deep respect for the founders, families, and leadership teams who have steered these enterprises with vision and conviction.

We look forward to honouring the stories, the legacies, and the next generation of leaders shaping India's growth story.

Four Awards. One Incredible Team.
 
We are deeply honoured to announce that Spark Capital PWM has been recognised at the Global Private Banker Innovation Awards 2026 across four prestigious categories — a reflection of the people, principles, and purpose that drive everything we do.
 
Outstanding Achievement by a Wealth Management CEO – Asia
A heartfelt congratulations to Arpita Vinay. Your vision, integrity, and relentless dedication continue to set the standard — not just for our firm, but for the industry at large.
 
Outstanding Wealth Management Service by a Multi-Family Office – Winner
This recognition affirms what we have always believed: that truly bespoke, client-first wealth management creates lasting impact. Every relationship. Every decision. Every time.
 
Outstanding Marketing Campaign by a Private Bank / Family Office / Trust Company – Winner
Great wealth management tells a story worth sharing. This award reflects our commitment to communicating with clarity, authenticity, and purpose — and to building connections that go beyond the transactional.
 
Best Digital Client Experience in Wealth Management – Advisory – Winner
Exceptional wealth management lives at the intersection of the human and the digital. We are proud that our investment in seamless, intuitive client experiences has been recognised at this level.

None of this happens without the extraordinary people behind Spark Capital PWM — our team, our partners, and above all, our clients.

Spark Capital PWM is honoured to be recognised as the Best Independent Asset Manager (India) at the WealthBriefingAsia Awards 2026, the fourteenth edition of one of Asia's most respected wealth management accolades.

Independence is not a feature. It is the foundation of everything we do.

Since our founding, we have built an advisory platform free from balance-sheet pressures, product quotas, and distribution incentives, because India's wealth creators deserve nothing less than advice that is fully aligned with their interests.

What sets our open-architecture platform apart is the institutional edge behind it. As a subsidiary of Spark Capital Advisors, with over two decades of investment banking and capital markets expertise, we bring a depth of deal insight, transaction experience, and market access that few independent wealth managers can match. This means our clients don't just benefit from conflict-free advice; they benefit from advice informed by genuine institutional rigour.

We are grateful to our clients for their trust, to our team for their unwavering commitment to client stewardship, and to WealthBriefingAsia for this distinction.

At Spark Capital PWM, we believe that world-class service starts behind the scenes. That's why we're thrilled to share that we've successfully migrated our entire core infrastructure to a CtrlS Tier-IV Data Centre — one of the most advanced, resilient, and secure data centre environments available.
 
This wasn't just a technical migration. It was a team effort — 5+ experts, 50+ servers, up to 100 TB of data, and zero downtime. All delivered within 2 months. 
 
Here's what it means for our clients:
 - Faster speeds & seamless experience
 - Advanced security & compliance
 - Consistent, uninterrupted uptime
 - Scalability to match your growing needs
 - Environmentally efficient operations
 
We're not just upgrading technology — we're reinforcing our promise of reliability, security, and excellence for every customer.
 
Thank you to our incredible team and partners for making this milestone possible. And thank you to our clients for your continued trust and partnership.
